label: General shopper
guidance: Default brand voice. No audience-specific framing.

label: Professional / business buyer
guidance: Lead with reliability, precise specifications and total cost of ownership. Frame benefits around productivity, dependability and professional use cases. Precise, no-nonsense tone.

label: Student / budget-conscious
guidance: Lead with value, versatility and everyday practicality. Frame benefits around affordability and getting more for less. Friendly, approachable tone.

label: Premium / gift buyer
guidance: Lead with craftsmanship, design and the experience of owning or giving the product. Frame benefits around quality and occasion. Elevated, confident tone, with no invented superlatives.
